title: Villager Replant
summary: Farmer villagers replant the crop they just harvested, so carrot rows stay carrots and wheat rows stay wheat. Server side, Fabric 26.3.

gallery.title: Rows keep their crop
gallery.description: Plots (of 80) that grow the crop of their row, vanilla and with the mod, on a Fabric 26.3 dedicated server.

gallery.title: The farm after 4 minutes
gallery.description: Top-down view of the test farm: vanilla has turned most rows into carrots and potatoes, the mod kept every row.

gallery.title: The farm after 8 minutes
gallery.description: Late in the stress test the farmers ran out of wheat and beetroot seeds. The mod keeps those plots for their own crop.
